description.en: VSCode-style Git view for every DeepSeek Harness Session: source control, commit graph, and AI prompts for merge and review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 每个会话可用的 VSCode 风格 Git 视图：源码管理、提交图，以及合并/评审用的 AI prompt。

description.en: VS Code-style Git view for DSH sessions: source control (stage, commit, diff), a branch-lane commit graph with inline commit details, a searchable branch filter, and AI prompts for merge/review — for every Session working directory, including nested repositories, with a picker that probes one directory level at a time.
description.zh: 会话可用的 VS Code 风格 Git 视图：源码管理（暂存、提交、diff）、带行内提交详情的分支泳道提交图、可搜索的分支过滤，以及合并/评审用的 AI prompt；支持会话工作目录和下级 Git 仓库，仓库选择器按层展开、点开哪层才探测哪层。
